business: Hashim Group Advocates and Legal Consultants
summary: A Dubai advocates group established in 1991 appears to lose corporate clients to a free builder address, a 2015 footer and a free mail address.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free Wix address, with a banner that says This website was built on Wix.
findings.cost: A free builder address makes a long established firm look temporary.
findings.fix: Your own domain and a clean branded site.

findings.cost: An old year suggests the firm is not active online.
findings.fix: A footer that updates by itself.

findings.problem: The contact email appears to be a mail.com address instead of one on the firm's own domain.
findings.cost: A free mail address makes a corporate client doubt the firm.
findings.fix: An email address on your own domain.

findings.problem: No WhatsApp and no client reviews appear on the pages.
findings.cost: Clients choosing a firm look for proof and a quick way to message.
